description: This file defines the ProcessingDecorator class, which extends an abstract decorator class and provides functionality to process HTML tags with callbacks and attribute modifications within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_ProcessingDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for processing HTML tags with customizable callbacks and attributes in the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with parameters such as tag name, callback, regexp, and attributes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Processes content by applying the callback or default processing to matching tags.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern used to match tags, creating a default pattern if none was provided.

methods.name: getCallback
methods.description: Returns the callback function, creating a default one if none was provided.

methods.name: defaultCallback
methods.description: Default callback that adds specified attributes to matched elements.

methods.name: getAttributesString
methods.description: Generates a string of HTML attributes with dynamic values based on call count.
